title.en: Unify guided learning and language-specific Dashboard access
title.zh: 统一引导式学习体验与按语言区分的用户面板入口

purpose.en: Create a faster answer-feedback-continue rhythm across SmartLingo and give members direct, language-specific access to every core learning mode.
purpose.zh: 在 SmartLingo 统一更快的作答、反馈、继续节奏，并让会员按具体学习语言直接进入每个核心学习模式。

en: Auto-score choices when selected and sentence builders when every visible slot is filled.
Keep explicit Continue on feedback states without a separate Check stop; timed Challenge feedback advances after six seconds.
Add normal and slow model audio plus three scored follow-me attempts to relevant speaking practice.
Prioritize vocabulary by lowest difficulty then highest frequency and display both measures.
Give Today’s Sprint one language action and separate SmartCard, Challenge, Everyday Speaking, and Courses Dashboard sections.
Add a dedicated My Colleges page and a payment-backed College Coordinator path for creating colleges.
zh: 选择答案后自动判定，组句填满全部可见空位后自动判定。
反馈页保留明确的继续按钮，不再增加独立检查停顿；限时挑战反馈六秒后自动前进。
相关口语练习提供正常与慢速示范及三次评分跟读。
按最低难度、同级最高常用度挑选词汇，并显示两项指标。
今日速成只保留一个添加语言入口，用户面板分别展示智慧卡、智慧卡挑战、生活口语和课程。
新增我的学院页面，并提供经支付验证的学院协调员开设学院路径。

en: Today’s Sprint, Beginner five-skill learning, SmartCard practice and Challenge, Everyday Speaking, member Dashboard, account menu, colleges, and Stripe subscription webhooks
zh: 今日速成、初级五技能学习、智慧卡练习与挑战、生活口语、会员用户面板、账户菜单、学院及 Stripe 订阅回调

en: Anonymous learners start a fresh Sprint from the Sprint picker while signed-in learners resume D1-backed progress.
Dashboard tiles state the interface-to-target language direction and send each add action to its feature-specific selector.
Move college creation out of the Dashboard and authorize it through the existing permanent administrator boundary or an active College Coordinator subscription.
Preserve SmartLingo-owned branding, data, Clerk, Cloudflare, AI, and commerce boundaries.
zh: 匿名学习者从今日速成选择页开始新进度，登录学习者则继续 D1 保存的学习状态。
用户面板卡片显示界面语言到目标语言的学习方向，每个添加入口进入对应功能的专用选择页。
从用户面板移除学院开设功能，并通过既有永久管理员边界或有效的学院协调员订阅授权。
保留 SmartLingo 自有品牌、数据、Clerk、Cloudflare、AI 与商业边界。

en: Vinext production build and all 344 automated tests passed with zero failures.
Migration validation, sensitive-data scan, diff check, and shared site policy, architecture, base-feature, and contract gates passed.
Local responsive browser verification passed for the Sprint language-and-duration selector; production verification follows the GitHub Actions to Cloudflare release.
zh: Vinext 生产构建及全部 344 项自动化测试通过，失败为零。
数据库迁移验证、敏感数据扫描、差异检查，以及共享站点政策、架构、基础功能和契约检查全部通过。
今日速成语言与时长选择页已通过本地响应式浏览器验证；发布后继续通过 GitHub Actions 到 Cloudflare 的生产验收。

en: No automated tests are intentionally deferred for this release.
zh: 本次发布没有有意延期的自动化测试。

en: Apply proven single-focus exercise pacing while retaining SmartLingo’s own brand, data model, characters, assets, and services.
Preserve Clerk, Cloudflare, AI gateway, commerce, and site-owned data boundaries.
zh: 采用成熟的单题聚焦节奏，同时保留 SmartLingo 自有品牌、数据模型、角色、素材与服务。
保持 Clerk、Cloudflare、AI 网关、商业及站点自有数据边界。
